name: Titamon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [DM] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] All of your [Ver.4] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
